description: Token-efficiency ratios for a scope, project or set of providers: cache hit rate, reasoning and output shares of all tokens, input:output ratio, cost per 1M tokens and average cost per request — overall and per model, plus an estimated caching saving. Use it to compare how models spend tokens. For what caching actually saved in dollars and how many cache writes were never read back, use tokmeter_cache_efficiency; to rank models on one metric, use tokmeter_leaderboard.

scope.description: Time scope: today, week (last 7d), month (calendar month), or all (default)

name: tokmeter_efficiency
